items.title: How we will do better for Australia
items.summary: OpenAI apologises for incidents involving Australian government websites and outlines stronger safeguards and support to strengthen Australia’s cyber defences.

items.title: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with $5 million in funding and up to $5 million in software credits and engineering support.
